import html # Template for displaying a blog post; placeholders are {title} and {body} BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post safely for display in an HTML page. Parameters ---------- title : str The blog post title. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully rendered HTML snippet containing the sanitized title and body. Raises ------ ValueError If either `title` or `body` is None or an empty string. """ if title is None or body is None: raise ValueError("Title and body must not be None.") if not title.strip() or not body.strip(): raise ValueError("Title and body must not be empty.") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False).replace('\n', '
') return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
